parts.t: Perched above West Vancouver, the British Properties is synonymous with luxury and exclusivity. This prestigious enclave features sprawling estate homes with panoramic views of Vancouver, the ocean, and the Gulf Islands. It is one of Canada's most coveted residential addresses.
